text_b: La reserva fue confirmada ayer por ella.

text_a: Tell him the invoice is overdue.
text_b: Tell her the invoice is overdue.
what_differs: Different addressee (him vs her).

text_a: Eu aprovei o orçamento antes da reunião.
text_b: Ele aprovou o orçamento antes da reunião.
what_differs: First-person vs third-person subject: who approved changes.

text_a: They will present the findings on Monday.
text_b: He will present the findings on Monday.
what_differs: Singular 'they' could refer to a person who is 'he', or to a group; unclear.

text_a: Trae tu credencial a la reunión.
text_b: Trae la credencial tuya a la reunión.

text_a: Please send your report to our manager.
text_b: Please send your report to your manager.
what_differs: Recipient manager differs (our vs your).

text_a: Revise o meu código antes do deploy.
text_b: Revise o seu código antes do deploy.
what_differs: Whose code to review: speaker's vs addressee's.

text_a: Dile a Ana que traiga su laptop.
text_b: Dile a Ana que traiga la laptop de ella.
what_differs: 'su' may mean Ana's, the listener's, or a third party's laptop.

text_a: The bank closed at noon yesterday.
text_b: Yesterday the bank closed at noon.

text_a: La tienda cerró a las seis.
text_b: La tienda cierra a las seis.
what_differs: Past event vs present/habitual schedule.

text_a: O sistema fechou o chamado automaticamente.
text_b: O sistema fecha o chamado automaticamente.
what_differs: One past occurrence vs general present behavior.

text_b: Mayor signs the bill.
what_differs: Headline-style present can narrate a past event; tense ambiguous.

text_a: Put the logo above the title.
text_b: Place the title below the logo.

text_a: Firma a la izquierda de la fecha.
text_b: La fecha va a la derecha de la firma.

text_a: Coloque o anexo antes da assinatura.
text_b: Coloque o anexo depois da assinatura.
what_differs: Before vs after the signature.

text_a: Sort the list so the first item is the oldest.
text_b: Sort the list in ascending order.
what_differs: Ascending depends on the sort key; may or may not be by age.

text_a: The service is unavailable on weekends.
text_b: The service is not available on weekends.

text_a: El pago se hace sin comisión.
text_b: El pago no incluye comisión.
Quarto com café da manhã opcional.
what_differs: Breakfast excluded vs available as an option.

text_b: The seat is not occupied.
what_differs: Double negation means occupied; single negation means free.

text_b: The tank is nearly empty.
El motor está muy caliente.
what_differs: Degree of heat: slight vs high.

text_b: O prazo está totalmente vencido.
what_differs: Almost expired vs fully expired.

text_b: The results are marginally significant.
what_differs: Both mean borderline, but 'barely' may or may not cross the threshold.

text_a: El total es de 119 euros con IVA.
text_b: El total es de 119 euros, IVA incluido.
The fee is $50 before tax.
O valor bruto é R$ 800.
what_differs: Net vs gross amount.

text_b: Price is $200 including taxes.
what_differs: All-in may also cover fees and extras, not only taxes.

text_b: Please respond ASAP.
Send it right away.
Responda imediatamente.
what_differs: No urgency vs immediate urgency.

text_a: Send it by end of week.
text_b: Send it by Friday.
what_differs: End of week may be Friday, Saturday, or Sunday depending on the reader.

text_b: Refer to ticket #123 for details.
Upgrade to version 2.10 before launch.
what_differs: Version 2.1 and 2.10 are different releases.

text_a: La reunión es en la sala 4B.
text_b: La reunión es en la sala 4D.
what_differs: Different room identifier (4B vs 4D).

text_b: Atualize para a versão 2.1.0.
what_differs: 2.1 and 2.1.0 are often the same release but not always by convention.

text_b: Run the backup of the database nightly.
Abre la plantilla del informe.
Contate o atendimento ao cliente.
Restore the database backup.
what_differs: A standby database vs a backup file/copy of the database.
